meta.title: The Client Graph
meta.subtitle: A Canopy state machine whose only job is to arm the snapshot system, and to notice when it stops

views.label: The happy path
views.note: root is always active; connecting is its default child; gameplay is the destination.

views.label: What holds the gate
views.note: The Startup Gate advances only when every block reports completed.

views.label: Losing the connection
views.note: The tracker block on root runs in every child state, so a drop is caught anywhere.

cards.title: Why the gate cannot be skipped
items: Client Go In Game operates on InitializeState
Only a Startup Gate supplies InitializeState
Only the Initialize block can drive a gate from a state
The type system enforces the chain — you cannot wire it wrong

cards.title: Idempotence without a flag
items: The node keys the sent RPC on the connection identity, in GroveState
New connection entity after a reconnect: resend, correctly
The gate itself is the retry loop — no timers, no coroutines

cards.title: Why the tracker lives on root
items: Blocks on root run every tick in every child state
Put it on connecting and disconnects stop being detected once in game
Connection events survive one tick — the tracker latches them into a snapshot

cards.title: The falsifiable check
items: Delete the workaround system, run, read the machine's state id
state = gameplay is reachable only through the gate
So the reading proves the graph sent the RPC, not leftover code
